G'oya

Qoldiq bu hisob ochilgandan beri bo'lgan barcha amallarning ishorali yig'indisi: tushum plyus, yechish minus. "Shu paytgacha yig'indi" oyna funksiyasi bilan bitta qatorda yoziladi: SUM(...) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY ...).

Yechim

SELECT account_id, id, created_at,
       SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END)
         OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS balance
FROM transactions
ORDER BY account_id, created_at, id

CASE summaga ishora beradi, PARTITION BY har hisobni alohida sanaydi, ORDER BY created_at, id esa amallar bajarilgan tartib. Oxiridagi ORDER BY alohida: oyna ichidagi tartib natija qatorlari tartibini belgilamaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Oyna ichida faqat created_at yozilsa, so'rov xato bermaydi, lekin namunadagi 2-hisobda 12:00:00 dagi ikki amal bir xil qoldiq oladi. Sababi standart freym: ORDER BY bo'lsa, u RANGE ... CURRENT ROW, ya'ni tartib qiymati teng bo'lgan barcha qatorlarni birdaniga qo'shadi.

Noto'g'riSELECT account_id, id, created_at,
       SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END)
         OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY created_at) AS balance
FROM transactions
ORDER BY account_id, created_at, id

id qo'shilgach tartib yagona bo'ladi va muammo yo'qoladi. Xuddi shu natijani ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ham beradi, lekin teng vaqtli amallar tartibi baribir id bilan aniqlanishi kerak.

Faqat id bo'yicha tartib ham noto'g'ri: id amal yozilgan tartib, bajarilgan tartib emas. Bank tizimlarida kechikib yozilgan amallar ko'p uchraydi.
